scoring_justification: MAPE and relative error recomputed from agent's output power CSV against inline digitized experimental data.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden experimental output power vs. load resistance reference curve
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Digitized from Fig. 8 of the source paper using WebPlotDigitizer
hidden_assets.generation_method: Data points extracted from the published figure; values at required load resistances (2,3,4,5,6,7,8 Ω) were read off.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Derived from actual published experimental data; no random numbers were added.

outputs.description: CSV containing predicted output voltage and output power versus load resistance for the TEG system at fixed inlet air conditions (500 K, 45.67 m/s) and cooling water (300 K, 7.04 m/s). The hidden checker compares these predictions against hidden digitized experimental data from the paper to compute MAPE and relative error at a load close to 4 Ω, awarding full credit when errors fall below set thresholds.

output_contract.notes: The agent must implement the fully coupled simulation using an open-source multiphysics solver (ElmerFEM recommended). All geometry dimensions, material polynomials, and boundary conditions are fully specified in the task instruction; no external data files need to be downloaded.
